reviews.Author: Gluten Free Vegan
reviews.OriginDescription: Reviewed in the United States on August 12, 2026
reviews.Text: This is the most expensive salt I have ever purchased. It’s a TINY bag for $24. It looks like a big bag in the picture, but it is not. I haven’t tried it yet but I’m giving this review so you can ensure that you’re looking at the actual amount of half a cup.
reviews.Title: This is a tiny bag of salt for $24

reviews.Author: Pati
reviews.OriginDescription: Reviewed in the United States on February 14, 2026
reviews.Text: RIP OFF!!!!! $20 FOR 4 OZ? I never dreamed it would be SO TINY!!!!!!! RIP OFF RIP OFF!!! I thought it was 14 OZ which is expensive enough! Really a SICK GREEDY company!!
reviews.Title: RIP OFF!

reviews.Author: Susan Hume
reviews.OriginDescription: Reviewed in the United States on January 10, 2026
reviews.Text: FYI: they show a picture of the 1 lbs. container but you only get 4 ounces of SALT. This has to be the worlds most expensive salt😕
reviews.Title: World most expensive salt. 20.00 for 4 ounces

reviews.Author: Melissa H.
reviews.OriginDescription: Reviewed in the United States on September 16, 2025
reviews.Text: Be careful!!! Be sure and look at the weight. This is a very small amount of salt for nearly $20. My fault that I did not check the weight. Non-refundable
reviews.Title: Very expensive

reviews.Author: Eliana Chavez
reviews.OriginDescription: Reviewed in the United States on June 7, 2025
reviews.Text: Decepcionada, pensé que pagaba casi $20 por una sal de calidad, pero al recibir el producto me doy cuenta que es una sal refinada, o sea que ha perdido todos los nutrientes y que lo único que contiene es sodio y esta es la que juega el importante papel de aumentar la presión arterial. Es imposible hacer devolución de este producto
reviews.Title: No compres este producto

reviews.Author: Steven Smith
reviews.OriginDescription: Reviewed in the United States on March 19, 2025
reviews.Text: In shipping this beautiful flake salt became a powdered mess of powdered salt. Absolute waste of $. The whole point is to have flakes. That’s what makes it expensive. Now it’s expensive waste of powder.
reviews.Title: Shipping destroys the flaked salt into powder - waste of $

reviews.Author: Nathan Wilde
reviews.OriginDescription: Reviewed in the United States on February 6, 2025
reviews.Text: This is so deceptive! The photos make it seem like this is a medium sized bag. It’s tiny. Not even a hand full of salt
reviews.Title: Super small

reviews.Author: Jesse
reviews.OriginDescription: Reviewed in the United States on December 28, 2024
reviews.Text: Small little bag and extremely expensive. Rip off. Can’t return. This is a scam! I’d give it 0 stars if I could. The product is prob fine but this is stealing and manipulating
reviews.Title: Tiny and expensive

reviews.Author: Jr
reviews.OriginDescription: Reviewed in the United States on September 3, 2024
reviews.Text: Received the WORLD’S SMALLEST bag of salt. CANNOT RETURN so I DO NOT recommend :(
reviews.Title: DO NOT RECOMMEND

reviews.Author: Amazon Customer
reviews.OriginDescription: Reviewed in the United States on May 28, 2024
reviews.Text: Upon receipt I noticed there was a dead spider inside the sealed bag.
reviews.Title: Spider in our sealed bag

reviews.Author: Amazon Customer
reviews.OriginDescription: Reviewed in the United States on August 20, 2023
reviews.Text: It’s my fault for not realizing how little you get and it is not returnable, but it is the tiniest package of salt for the price. I mean tiny. I should have read it more closely.
reviews.Title: Not a good value for price

reviews.Author: Brock S.
reviews.OriginDescription: Reviewed in the United States on March 21, 2023
reviews.Text: They don’t allow returns or if send this back. This flame salt looks and tastes exactly the same as the their kosher sea salt (see photo) the flake is a complete waste of money. They are charging a premium just for “flake” name. Stick to just the Jacobsen Kosher sea salt.
reviews.Title: Waste of money, stick with Kosher

reviews.Author: Susan
reviews.OriginDescription: Reviewed in the United States on January 5, 2022
reviews.Text: I received an open packet of this salt and returns on this item aren’t allowed. Who knows if it actually contains Jacobsen salt.
reviews.Title: Sent previously opened packet!

reviews.Author: Geene L Felix
reviews.OriginDescription: Reviewed in the United States on December 20, 2020
reviews.Text: Tiny tiny - I have purchased this brand before and love the product. Buyer beware of the size. I would return if I could but they won't let me. Waste of money. Can buy a larger container in stores for the price of this.
reviews.Title: Tiny not worth it

reviews.Author: Amazon Customer
reviews.OriginDescription: Reviewed in the United States on May 5, 2020
reviews.Text: There was a hair INSIDE the bag. Hard to believe because it’s sealed! Would love a new one, because there is a no return policy
reviews.Title: Hair inside salt

reviews.Author: JKG
reviews.OriginDescription: Reviewed in the United States on September 20, 2018
reviews.Text: Beware. This is the tiniest bag of salt you have ever seen. And $11!!!! I am shocked.
reviews.Title: Beware!!
